scope: All existing F407 application directories replayed against one bundle. Software cohesion only; this finite test plan is not the full manufacturer capability inventory and is not physical acceptance.

limitations: Historical physical evidence belongs to its original artifact and bundle, not this rebuild.
No wire capture, button stimulus or live execution in this audit.
Existing failure/recovery anomalies remain unresolved; compilation does not establish repeatability.

Internal-reference conversion example only; external analog channels and electrical accuracy unqualified.
Controller-only compile integration; no wired slave transaction or electrical validation.
Output entry is retained for compilation, but EN1/EN2 remain disabled in main; no analog output behavior is claimed.
Internal loopback example only; not a normal external CAN bus or every interrupt path.
No fresh telemetry sampling or hardware action; historical CAN observations remain artifact-bound.
